name: My Very Own Lith
source:
My Very Own Lith is a text-based Flash game centered around an easily embarrassed cat boy (or girl) named Lith. You can befriend him, seduce him, submit to him, or dominate him, or combine these approaches as you like, and as you play the game, you will learn about Lith and help him to solve his own internal conflicts. Can you and Lith find happiness together, or will you linger forever in the Void?

The VN is still being worked on by its creator Lithier, and new visual art is being added as soon as he is able to get it drawn. The written portions go far beyond the currently illustrated portions at the time of writing, with three main branches that themselves both branch out into more minor branches, both before and after the branch is completed. Furthermore, there are still more choices and opportunities only available depending on the settings chosen at the start of the game.
translation:
《My Very Own Lith》是一款以文字为主的Flash游戏，围绕一名很容易害羞的猫男孩（或猫女孩）Lith展开。你可以和他成为朋友、引诱他、臣服于他或支配他，也可以随心组合这些方式。随着游戏推进，你会逐渐了解Lith，并帮助他解决内心的矛盾。你和Lith能一起找到幸福吗？还是会永远徘徊在虚空之中？

这部视觉小说仍在由创作者Lithier持续开发，新的视觉素材会在他画好后尽快加入。截至撰写本文时，文字内容已经远远超出目前绘制完成的部分：三条主要路线各自还会分出更多次要分支，且在路线完成前后都有分支。此外，根据游戏开始时选择的设置，仍有更多选择和机会等待发掘。
